overview.title: A clear view of what a learner knows
overview.intro: Tutors build versioned assessments from question pools. Students receive a timed, focused workspace. Families receive a tutor’s considered report after a conversation.

contract.title: Activity signals provide context, not proof
contract.body: The assessment can record timing, focus, fullscreen, connection, copy/paste, and answer-change events. A tutor reviews them alongside the work; the system does not make an accusation.

prepare.label: Tutor
prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.body: Author versioned questions, choose pool sizes, and set time or fullscreen requirements.

take.label: Student
take.title: Take
take.body: See the collection notice, work through a randomized paper, and confirm the honor statement.

review.label: Tutor + family
review.title: Understand
review.body: Review answers and activity context, consult together, then release a tutor-written diagnostic.

library.title: Available assessments
library.noDescription: Open the assessment brief and collection notice.

entry.noDescription: Review the details and activity notice before you begin.

notice.label: Before you begin
notice.title: This assessment records activity signals
notice.body: You will see the same kinds of activity a tutor may review after the assessment:
notice.focus: tab or focus changes and fullscreen exits
notice.connection: connection interruptions and detectable copy/paste attempts
notice.examMode: keyboard shortcuts, clipboard, and the right-click menu are restricted for the duration
notice.camera: your camera must stay on and visible
notice.headTracking: on-device face, gaze, and eyes-closed tracking runs locally in your browser — no video ever leaves your device
notice.objectDetection: on-device object detection checks your camera view for phones and other unusual items — no video ever leaves your device
notice.evidenceCapture: a still photo is saved and shared with your tutor when this assessment detects multiple faces, your face missing, a possible external device, a phone or unusual item, or your eyes closed for a sustained period
notice.newTab: the assessment opens in a new browser tab, with your camera preview and the questions side by side

integrityPolicy.warn: If this assessment detects {count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}} of leaving the exam (switching tabs, exiting fullscreen, losing focus, or minimizing the window), you will see an on-screen warning
integrityPolicy.auto_submit: If this assessment detects {count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}} of leaving the exam (switching tabs, exiting fullscreen, losing focus, or minimizing the window), it will be automatically submitted

notice.notProof: These signals provide context only. They are not proof of misconduct. Any automatic action this specific assessment takes is described above — no other assessment behaves this way.

ready.title: Ready to begin?
ready.fullscreen: Starting opens the focused fullscreen workspace. Leaving fullscreen is recorded as an activity signal.
ready.standard: The question order and values are fixed for this attempt once you start.

entry.cameraConsent: I explicitly consent to the camera requirement described in policy {policy}. I understand this slice does not record video or analyze my face or emotions.

opened.title: Your assessment opened in a new tab
opened.body: Switch to the new tab to confirm your camera and begin. You can close this tab.
opened.blockedBody: Your browser blocked the new tab. Use the button below to open it yourself.

runner.elapsedNotice: Time has elapsed. Your saved answers remain available; accept the honor statement to submit them.
runner.question: Question {current} of {total}

submit.title: Submit your saved answers
submit.body: You can review your answers above. The honor statement is required before submission.
submit.honor: I confirm that this submission reflects my own work and that I followed the assessment instructions.

complete.title: Your assessment is complete
complete.body: Your tutor can now review the answers and activity context. Any diagnostic report is written by the tutor and shared with your family after consultation.

closedByPolicy.title: This attempt was automatically submitted
closedByPolicy.body: Your tutor set this assessment to close automatically after repeated tab switches, fullscreen exits, or similar activity, and that limit was reached. Your saved answers were kept. Your tutor will review this attempt and can follow up with you.

signals.unusual_item_detected: Unusual item detected in camera view
signals.eyes_closed: Eyes closed for a sustained period

preflight.title: Camera check
preflight.body: Confirm your camera before you begin. Sit facing the camera in good light, with your whole face visible and no hat or face covering.
preflight.keepVisible: Keep your face visible throughout the assessment
preflight.confirmed: Camera confirmed. You're ready to begin.

errors.unsupported: This browser does not support camera access. Try a recent version of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
errors.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings, then try again.
errors.no-device: No camera was found. Connect a camera and try again.
errors.unknown: The camera could not be started. Try again.

statusLine.medium: Elevated activity — your tutor will review this
statusLine.high: Review recommended — your tutor will review this closely
statusLine.limited: Camera is on; on-device face tracking is unavailable in this browser

warning.integrityPolicy: Your tutor has set an activity limit for this assessment, and it has been reached. Please stay on this page and continue your work — your tutor will review this attempt.

fullscreen.exited: Please return to fullscreen to continue the assessment.

attempts.empty: No student has started this assessment yet.
attempts.deleteConfirm: Delete this assessment? Students will no longer see or be able to start it. Past attempts and reports are kept and stay reachable from this page.

signals.title: Recorded signals
signals.contract: Counts describe browser activity only. They do not establish intent or prove misconduct. Review them with the answers and speak with the learner when context is needed.

suspicion.title: Suspicion overview
suspicion.notProof: This score summarizes signal weight for your review. It is never a verdict, and this score never fails or blocks a submission by itself — the decision is always yours. (If you set an activity-based auto-submit policy for this assessment, that is a separate, disclosed setting — see the assessment's attempts and activity policy.)

evidence.title: Evidence photos
evidence.empty: No evidence photos were logged for this attempt.

timeline.title: Event timeline
timeline.empty: No events were recorded for this attempt.

answers.title: Student answers
answers.changes: {count, plural, one {# saved change} other {# saved changes}}

report.title: Diagnostic report
report.body: Write the interpretation in your own words. Browser events are context, not a generated conclusion.

release.title: Consult before sharing
release.waiting: The report remains private to teaching staff until the parent consultation is recorded.
release.consulted: Consultation recorded. Review the report once more before releasing it to the linked parent.
release.released: The report has been released to the linked parent.

newAssessment.title: Create an assessment
newAssessment.intro: Build a versioned assessment from question to question. Publish it now or save a draft to keep refining it before students see it.
newAssessment.subject: Subject
newAssessment.noSubjects: No subjects are available yet. Ask an administrator to add one before creating an assessment.
newAssessment.durationHint: Leave blank for an untimed assessment.
newAssessment.publishHint: Drafts are visible only to you. Students only ever see published assessments.
newAssessment.correctAnswer: Correct answer (optional, for your own reference)

proctoring.fullscreen: Require fullscreen and lock down keyboard shortcuts, clipboard, and the right-click menu
proctoring.fullscreenHint: Turns on strict exam mode: keyboard shortcuts, copy/paste, the context menu, and dragging content out of the page are blocked.
proctoring.cameraHint: Students must pass a camera check before starting and stay on camera for the duration.
proctoring.headTracking: Enable on-device face, gaze, and eyes-closed tracking
proctoring.headTrackingHint: Runs entirely in the student's browser. No video is recorded or uploaded — only face-presence, count, gaze-direction, and sustained-eyes-closed signals are logged.
proctoring.objectDetection: Enable on-device phone and unusual-item detection
proctoring.objectDetectionHint: Runs a second on-device model that checks the camera view for phones, laptops, books, or remotes — no video is recorded or uploaded, only the detection is logged.
proctoring.evidenceCaptureHint: When multiple faces, a missing face, a possible external device, a phone or unusual item, or sustained eyes-closed is detected, a single still photo is uploaded and logged for your review — never continuous video.

audience.noStudents: You have no assigned students yet. Ask an administrator to assign students before restricting this assessment to specific ones.

integrity.maxAttemptsHint: Leave blank to allow unlimited attempts. Only completed (submitted) attempts count toward this limit.
integrity.action: If a student repeatedly leaves the assessment (switches tabs, exits fullscreen, loses focus, or minimizes the window)

actionOption.log_only: Just log it for my review (default)
actionOption.warn: Show the student an on-screen warning

actionHint.log_only: Nothing changes for the student. You'll still see every recorded signal when you review their attempt.
actionHint.warn: The student sees a clear on-screen notice once they reach the limit below. Their attempt keeps running — you still decide what happens next.
actionHint.auto_submit: Once the limit below is reached, the attempt is ended automatically and the student is told why. This is disclosed to the student before they start.

integrity.violationLimit: Number of instances before this applies
integrity.violationLimitHint: Counts tab switches, fullscreen exits, focus loss, and window minimizing together.

validation.subject: Choose a subject.
validation.title: Add a title.
validation.choices: Question {number} needs at least two answer choices.
validation.audience: Select at least one student, or choose "Every student".
validation.violationLimit: Set a number of instances for this policy.

errors.load: The assessment could not be loaded.
errors.start: The assessment could not be started.
errors.fullscreen: Fullscreen could not be started. Check your browser's fullscreen permissions and try again.
errors.save: This answer could not be saved.
errors.submit: The assessment could not be submitted.
errors.review: The attempt review could not be loaded.
errors.report: The diagnostic report could not be updated.
errors.create: The assessment could not be created.
errors.delete: The assessment could not be deleted.
